notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-Pause function on controller
-Mapping system changed ( it seems that some players didn’t know that mapping the controller was possible)
-Stage Select function at the beginning of the game ( in the How to Play screen ) up to the higher level visited. 
-Upgrade Sword items loads the 10 Sword Impulses when you have this power.

notes.title: Update 2020-03-08
notes.content:
-Unlimited continues in all difficulty modes
-Hability to cancel the sword attack or striking while changing direction
-Max HP +1containers give a bonus of +2 current HP
-Items last longer before disappearing
-An icon shows that you need a key when you try to open a chest without having one.

Concerning the PAUSE on controllers. Many things have been tried and I’m still trying to make that but it doesn’t work once the game is on the STEAM envirronement for some reason. Do not forget you can map the controller with the STEAM CONTROLLER option on your STEAM account. Simply assign SPACE on the chosen button of the controller. 
Then you will have PAUSE assigned on your controller.
